title: Auk Mini 2 Indoor Smart Garden Review: Better Where It Counts
summary: Using the Auk Connect app isn’t mandatory; you can still control the light schedule manually using a button on the light bar, as with the Auk Mini 1. Otherwise, the Mini Auk 1 and Mini Auk 2 are quite similar.
